title: CSV Column Sums (stdin)
hints: Keep empty cells when splitting so columns stay aligned.
Split with `omittingEmptySubsequences: false`, trim each cell, and add it if it parses as `Double`.
Print whole sums as `Int`: `sum == sum.rounded() ? String(Int(sum)) : String(sum)`.
jsBridge: Split on commas, parse with `Double(_:)`, sum per column. The same as JS's `split(',')` + `parseFloat`, except failures give `nil` instead of `NaN`. Real CSV (quoted commas) needs a real parser, in any language.
